Eastern_Fleet.INITIAL: Returns Trincomalee on 12 Mar after training/show-of-force. Japanese late cue from deliberate 11-Mar W/T advertising is insufficient for a weapon-quality intercept before return.
Eastern_Fleet.post_INITIAL: BACKGROUND_FREEZE. Routine exercises/patrols are not advanced as major events.
Eastern_Fleet.historical_DIPLOMAT_guard: Do not copy historical 21-Mar DIPLOMAT because its US carrier rendezvous depended on Saratoga CV-3, a permanent Branch carrier loss. Any analogous US/RN carrier cooperation requires a new explicit allocation decision.

Bengal_Arakan_land.Japan: No Feni/Comilla offensive; hold Chittagong/Patenga, repair logistics and local defense.
Bengal_Arakan_land.Allies: No immediate Chittagong recapture offensive; rebuild/re-equip north of the line.
Bengal_Arakan_land.air: Use corrected larger local air pools for CAP, sweep, interdiction and reconnaissance, but no event-level land advance is generated absent a ground-operation gate.
